title:
set -euo pipefail
stage=/g/JiBuildCache/stage4-linux-0.1.3
app=/e/Projects/Code/AI/Ji/ji-java/products/ji-standalone/build/install/ji-host
jre=/g/JiBuildCache/temurin/OpenJDK21U-jre_x64_linux_hotspot_21.0.12.1_1.tar.gz
raw=/g/JiBuildCache/ji-host-0.1.3-linux-x64-java21.tar
archive=${raw}.gz
rm -rf "$stage" "$raw" "$archive"
mkdir -p "$stage/ji-host" "$stage/jre"
cp -R "$app/bin" "$app/lib" "$stage/ji-host/"
tar -xzf "$jre" -C "$stage/jre"
cp -R "$stage/jre/jdk-21.0.12.1+1-jre" "$stage/ji-host/runtime"
tar --sort=name --mtime='UTC 2026-09-05' --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode='u=rwX,go=rX' \
  --exclude='ji-host/bin/ji-host' --exclude='ji-host/runtime/bin/*' \
  --exclude='ji-host/runtime/lib/jexec' --exclude='ji-host/runtime/lib/jspawnhelper' \
  -cf "$raw" -C "$stage" ji-host
mapfile -t runtime_bins < <(cd "$stage" && printf '%s\n' ji-host/runtime/bin/*)
executables=(ji-host/bin/ji-host "${runtime_bins[@]}")
for candidate in ji-host/runtime/lib/jexec ji-host/runtime/lib/jspawnhelper; do test ! -f "$stage/$candidate" || executables+=("$candidate"); done
( cd "$stage" && tar --sort=name --mtime='UTC 2026-09-05' --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=0755 --append -f "$raw" "${executables[@]}" )
gzip -n "$raw"
java_mode=$(tar -tvzf "$archive" ji-host/runtime/bin/java | tail -n 1 | cut -c1-10)
launcher_mode=$(tar -tvzf "$archive" ji-host/bin/ji-host | tail -n 1 | cut -c1-10)
test "$java_mode" = '-rwxr-xr-x'
test "$launcher_mode" = '-rwxr-xr-x'
printf 'java=%s launcher=%s\n' "$java_mode" "$launcher_mode"
sha256sum "$archive"
rm -rf "$stage"
